benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: SBM ZET Credit Card** is a co-branded credit card offered against an **FD worth minimum Rs. 2,000**. This FD-backed card is available on **RuPay network** and hence can be used to make **UPI transactions** by adding it to third-party UPI apps, like PhonePe, Google pay, CRED, and others. This card does **not require any credit history, income proof or documentation** and is thus **suitable for beginners who are new to credit** and wish to**build their credit scores**. Note: This card is also available in partnership with DCB and IOB, with no joining or annual fees._

faqs.q: What documents are required to apply for SBM ZET Credit Card?
faqs.a: No documents like income proof and others are required to apply for SBM ZET Credit Card application. However, you will have to provide PAN card and Aadhaar card details.

faqs.q: Is SBM ZET Credit Card a virtual card?
faqs.a: SBM ZET is offered as both virtual as well as physical card. You can get the virtual card instantly after completing the application process, though the latter can take around 7 days to be delivered to you.

faqs.q: What is the eligibility criteria to apply for SBM ZET Credit Card?
faqs.a: You must create an SBM fixed deposit of Rs. 5,000 or more to be eligible for SBM ZET Credit Card.

faqs.q: Can I use SBM ZET card to make UPI payments?
faqs.a: Yes, since SBM ZET is a RuPay credit card, you can add it to any third-party UPI app of choice to make UPI transactions.

faqs.q: Can I get SBM ZET Credit Card if my credit score is low?
faqs.a: Yes, SBM ZET credit card has 100% approval rate and is offered to all - new to credit customers, those with low credit score and those who already have credit cards.
